method: Read both enabled bodies and the single new canonical header in full. Independently decoded the complete bounded retail CFGs (1061/230 bytes, 0x409330..0x409754 and 0x409755..0x40983a), every branch direction and every ordered referent; then compiled the unit with the installed SP1 tools and compared all bytes with independent ordered-referent relocation. The decoded bodies agree instruction for instruction, including the plain-c2 `lea ebp,[esp-frame]` prologues, the GS cookie stores, the min-macro double-evaluation of wcslen, and the signed 1024 comparisons in LoadSearchPath. No decompiler output is relied on; the older draft was used only as a hypothesis and every byte was re-verified.

LoadSearchPath and LoadCLUI call LoadUILibrary by its exact mangled entry, and LoadCLUI calls LoadSearchPath; those ordered internal rel32 referents confirm same-unit ownership and the cdecl stack cleanup decoded at every call site (add esp,0x1c / pop).

Parameter and local names are descriptive placeholders, never claimed as PDB names.
